notes: Byte strings are lowercase hex; u64 seeds are 16 hex digits, big-endian. Every random byte comes from SplitMix64 (engine.md §31.2) seeded with the case's seed. `receipt` cases classify `frame` at seq `after + 1` with a fresh FakeSealer::create(seed of the log case, "Desk") that first classified the log's first `after` frames in order from M_0 (retained_from 1, every Skip target supplied, own_sealed the log's frames under Desk's dev by counter); the case then uses its `retained_from` for `chain_at` (C_b for retained_from <= b < seq), supplies the log's frames as Skip targets only when `targets_supplied`, and calls forget_roots_below(n) first when `forget_roots_below` is n. `expect.error` is a SealerError. Values checked by an independent script written from the spec text (not the crate's code): every value of `keys`, `genesis` (frame bytes included), `primitives`, `item`, `beat` and `snap`; for the log, every frame's layout, signature (fake) and AEAD tag under the epoch roots its rotations wrap, its frame hash and the chain values. Recorded from the crate's own output: the bytes of the later log frames and of the case frames (built by the crate; their `step` and expected class and code were chosen by hand from seal.md §14.2), the membership bytes after each receipt, and the snapshot blob.
